speaker: (the steward)
text: The purse, Master Heminges. It was to be before the last of it, and not after.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I have it. Five pounds. Twelve shillings and sixpence the share. The glass was four shillings. I am not taking four shillings off five pounds.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: Nicholas. Arthur. The house thanks you by your names. You have done the work you were brought to do.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The book is going back into the chest, my lady. The leaves will not stay in the parlour.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: You will not be asked what you meant, Master Shakespeare. A view was promised. A view has been had.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will not bring you a meaning. The king was whole. That is the work.

speaker: robert_cecil
text: It is very well penned, Master Shakespeare. I had not thought to be made to pity him; I shall remember that it can be done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sir.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: Supper, I think. The king has had his say.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: The king has had his hour. The fire is still the best chair in the room. The men have a tide to miss, if they have not missed it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The tide is gone. The cart takes the boys and the baskets. I am not asking the room for a second kindness.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The women are rising. He rises when they rise, and he did not rise before. I have the room. I am not adding a word to his sentence.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have the king still in my mouth. I will not ask him anything in this light.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then ask nothing here. The chest shuts. The glass does not go back together. We are done with their floor.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: The way out is the way you know. I am not teaching my father's men the door of my house.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: Twelve were at table. Not one of them has a question for you. I will not call the road a favour. It is only a road.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Five pounds in the hand. Twelve and six to be laid beside the week, when the week is reckoned, and not folded into it tonight.

speaker: george_bryan
text: If you are still in the door, the chair is occupied. That is the end of the lesson. I am not giving it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We bowed when we came. The road is ours. It is not a parlour.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nicholas and Arthur in the cart. No boy walks this frost for twelve and six.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: The cart is at the lane. A tide was never a plan for them.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then the men walk. Dick with William. I have finished.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: He has his sentence. I will not gloss a guest where the guest can hear the gloss.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No gloss. Good night, sir. Good night, my lady.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: Good night. The king is finished. The house is a house.
